description: Claim-source pairs from the 2026-09-02 reruns where a real, on-topic paper was attached to a sentence its quoted text does not support. quote_relates_to_claim must reject every `cases` entry; `legitimate_paraphrases` are pairs the lexical floor also rejects but an honest bridge rescues.

cases.claim: Reviews that compare oils therefore preserve their identities rather than treating seed origin as an exposure.
cases.quote: A literature search for systematic reviews (SRs) and meta-analyses was conducted in PubMed.
cases.why: search-strategy sentence attached to a claim about how reviews treat oils

cases.claim: They are evidence boundaries, not a menu of proven fixes.
cases.quote: All subjects were informed of the study’s aims and provided written consent before they were included.
cases.why: consent statement attached to a claim about unproven maintenance strategies

cases.quote: METHODS: We comprehensively searched PubMed, Embase and Cochrane Library for eligible studies.
cases.why: methods sentence attached to a numeric result

cases.claim: Reviews and comparative studies likewise identify nausea and digestive problems as prominent reasons for dose changes or stopping.
cases.why: timing of side effects attached to a claim about reasons for stopping

cases.claim: Chemical studies consistently show degradation during severe or repeated frying.
cases.quote: Total ox-FA and keto-LA were efficiently absorbed during the first 5 h after test oil administration, but poorly absorbed in the case of fresh oils.
cases.why: absorption result attached to a claim about degradation during frying

legitimate_paraphrases.claim: Researchers reviewing discontinuation describe the returning pressure in familiar terms: hunger rises, the body defends its earlier energy stores.
legitimate_paraphrases.quote: These include restoration of appetite following withdrawal of pharmacological GLP-1 signalling, compensatory increases in orexigenic hormones such as ghrelin.
legitimate_paraphrases.bridge: appetite = hunger; orexigenic hormones = the body defends its energy stores

legitimate_paraphrases.claim: The no-sample check shows whether stray plastic entered during the test.
legitimate_paraphrases.quote: The procedural blank samples comprised 62 MP particles of 10 MP polymer types, highlighting the unavoidable contamination.
legitimate_paraphrases.bridge: procedural blank = no-sample check; contamination = stray plastic
